name_en: Amego no hirarayaki — trout and vegetables grilled on a heated stone slab
summary_ja: 平たい石をかまどで数時間熱し、味噌で土手をつくってあめごや岩豆腐、こんにゃくを焼く祖谷地方の野外料理。平石を「ひらら」と呼ぶことが名の由来とされ、来客をもてなす料理として親しまれてきたという。
summary_en: A flat stone is heated over a hearth for hours, then a border of miso is built on it to grill amego trout, stone tofu, and konjac — an outdoor dish from the Iya valley. Its name comes from hirara, a local word for a flat stone, and it is said to have long served as a dish for entertaining guests.
source_title: あめごのひらら焼き 徳島県｜うちの郷土料理：農林水産省
